<button type="button" class="small ghost bb-copy" data-copy-preset hidden>
<textarea id="sp-body-{{ k }}" name="body" rows="10" maxlength="{{ e.max_chars }}" required aria-describedby="sp-hint-{{ k }} sp-count-{{ k }}" data-sp-body>

<form method="post" action="/workflows/building-blocks/system-prompts/{{ k }}/reset" class="inline-del" data-action-confirm="Go back to the built-in text for "{{ e.name }}"? Your versions are kept in the history.">
<button type="submit" class="small ghost" aria-label="Restore version {{ h.version }} of {{ e.name }}">
routing: <form method="post" action="/routing/{{ r.id }}/delete" class="rowform" data-action-confirm="Delete this routing rule?">
<form method="post" action="/routing/budgets/{{ b.row.id }}/delete" class="rowform" data-action-confirm="Delete this department budget?">
<input type="number" name="monthly_usd_limit" value="0" min="0" step="0.01" size="10" />
<form method="post" action="/routing/project-budgets/{{ st.budget_id }}/delete" class="rowform" data-action-confirm="Delete this project budget?">
_workflow_system_prompts: <form method="post" action="/workflows/{{ wf.id }}/system-prompts/{{ k }}/save" class="form wsp-form" data-wsp-form>

<textarea id="wsp-body-{{ k }}" name="body" rows="8" maxlength="{{ e.max_chars }}" required{% if not _open %} readonly{% endif %} aria-describedby="plk-wsp-{{ k }} wsp-hint-{{ k }} wsp-count-{{ k }}" data-wsp-body data-lock-field>

<form method="post" action="/workflows/{{ wf.id }}/system-prompts/{{ k }}/reset" class="inline-del wfl-restore" data-action-confirm="{{ t(request, 'page.workflow_builder.restore_head_confirm', name=e.name) }}">
<button type="submit" class="small ghost" aria-label="Restore version {{ h.version }} of {{ e.name }} for this workflow">
